headline: Stable negative sentiment (score: -50.3)
key_insights: Frustrations trending up 3% over 7 days (weak momentum)
sentiment_commentary:
• Optimism dominates today but in a negative sense — 52 quotes skew heavily mild, dragging the score to -48.7, one of the lower readings in the 232-day range.
• Frustrations remain elevated at 25.8 despite dropping sharply from yesterday's 79.6, driven by a high proportion of strong-intensity quotes (95 of 122).
• Fears are also in negative territory and fell further from yesterday, suggesting people are neither especially anxious nor venting much on that front today.
methodology: See METHODOLOGY.md. Scores use z-score normalization with empirically-derived intensity weights from analytics_config.yaml. Alerts at |z| >= threshold (configurable, default 2.0 for p < 0.05).
